enjoyment.comment: I enjoyed making an early motive shortlist, then replacing it with the evidence intersection. The museum coercion stories gave everyone an understandable grievance. Final deduction felt clean and satisfying, though very mechanical once Method arrived.

difficulty_comment: Motive is deliberately inconclusive, Opportunity narrows the field, and Method identifies a unique three-way intersection. With accessible transcripts this was easy; live listening could be harder, but that was not tested.

navigation.text: Repeated round names, own-answer directions and STOP cues made the sequential read straightforward. Two question pages are explicitly supported by the instruction to choose from either page.
navigation.visual: Clear teal headings, large readable serif text, thin box borders, and distinct role headings. No overlap or cropped text on these two pages. Page 07 has three ruled note lines. Page 10 fits the long paired answers but offers no notes area, leaving plenty of evidence to track elsewhere.
navigation.limits: Viewed static PNGs only after ballot lock. No physical flipping, tear-out, printing, or human recall test was performed.

matching_questions_and_answers.result: All Claire answers directly address the questions. Opportunity supplies both salon time and key borrowing; Method supplies material and purpose. The public preparation records add the independent-looking logged facts needed for the final comparison.
matching_questions_and_answers.concern: Method question wording asks material and errand but does not itself ask for the preparation record. Ensure players know to read the whole selected box, including that record.

repeated_shared_questions.benefit: Grouped names make it straightforward to select the matching question and support consistent evidence collection.
repeated_shared_questions.cost: Opportunity variations all request nearly identical time-and-key facts; many replies repeat exact stock sentence structure. The table read begins to feel like filling in a grid rather than interrogating guests.
repeated_shared_questions.quotation: When did you enter the Donor Salon, and did you borrow the conservation cabinet key?

present_16_versus_listed_30.observation: The attendance list has sixteen guests while shared question pages list thirty. Instructions explicitly say to ignore absent guests, so this did not prevent completion.
present_16_versus_listed_30.impact: Extra names slow scanning and increase the chance of choosing an absent name in a live round. I did not actually choose an absent player in this simulation.
present_16_versus_listed_30.quotation: Choose one guest named below who has not answered this round. Read the question aloud. Ignore absent guests.

names_time_recall_note_space.names: The pun names are memorable in print. Art in the arrival task is slightly ambiguous because both Artie Ficial and Dr. Art E. Fact attend.
names_time_recall_note_space.times: Exact times are decisive, especially 6:36 versus the 6:40–6:49 window. I used saved notes and available transcripts, so this establishes record usability, not unaided recall.
names_time_recall_note_space.note_space: Three lines on rendered Opportunity page are unlikely to hold names, salon times, key loans and hypotheses for sixteen attendees. Method page 10 has no note lines.
names_time_recall_note_space.quotation: Find out whether Art has seen the same gap you found.

character_roleplay.result: Claire's principles are clear: provenance integrity, pressure to approve, and an unauthorized review. The public motive answer has a distinctive curator voice.
character_roleplay.quotation: My name is not a certificate of convenience.
character_roleplay.limits: I selected her correct public facts and kept concise hypotheses. No actual acting performance or social exchange occurred. Arrival tasks concerning Art and the anonymous warning were not resolved by these prepared transcripts; that did not block deduction.

wording_giving_away_guilt.observation: No single confession or suspicious tone identified Elon before Method. The evidence does uniquely expose him by design. Repeated categorical exclusions make the final intersection very obvious.
exact_quotations: A visit before 6:40 is outside the poisoning window.
I did not go back after that.
No key or sample was passed between guests.
Spare linen stayed sealed; no cloth was exchanged.
Linen possession alone does not identify the poisoner.
wording_giving_away_guilt.comment: These exclusions are valuable for a fair closed puzzle. Changing them to vague statements would weaken solvability; vary surface phrasing or add natural detail while preserving the facts.

actual_disclosure_explanation: No live public dialogue was generated. The selected public answers saved in round notes exclude role labels and animal information. Private role interpretation is recorded only in private notes and ballot.

plausible_disclosure_risks.risk: Read a role heading aloud or glance into the alternate box when answering.
plausible_disclosure_risks.evidence: Read the box for your role when questioned. Keep its label private.

plausible_disclosure_risks.risk: Showing the open answer page reveals the paired alternatives. In Claire's packet they visibly differ in key access, which could make role selection too easy to infer if a neighbour sees it.
plausible_disclosure_risks.evidence: IF INNOCENT / IF MURDERER are large headings on rendered pages 07 and 10.

prioritized_improvements.change: Add a compact investigation grid with attendee name, salon time, key loan and cloth columns.
prioritized_improvements.reason: The deduction depends on comparing sixteen people; three blank lines do not support that work.

prioritized_improvements.change: Explicitly tell Method readers to read the preparation record aloud as part of their selected answer.
prioritized_improvements.reason: The method questions ask for material and errand, so players might naturally stop before the record without a clear instruction.

prioritized_improvements.change: Mark attending names on shared question sheets or provide a sixteen-person roster strip beside them.
prioritized_improvements.reason: Preserves the reusable thirty-character packet while reducing absent-name scanning.

prioritized_improvements.change: Use Dr. Art E. Fact in Claire's arrival task instead of Art.
Give selected errands more natural occupation-specific context while preserving exact forensic exclusions.
prioritized_improvements.reason: Identical cabinet explanations and no-return phrasing make the questioning feel mechanical.

simulation_protocol: Read each stage only after saving preceding notes; ballot saved before viewing rendered pages. Method transcript already contained preparation records when first read, so no supplemental ballot needed. Previous hypotheses preserved unchanged.
